summary: Verified P0 bug fixes: (1) Each destination page now shows country-specific packages - Greece shows 'Athens & Santorini Classic', Japan shows 'Tokyo & Kyoto Classic', India shows 'Golden Triangle Classic', etc. India packages no longer appear on other destination pages. (2) Flights service image (photo-1556388158-158ea5ccacbd) loads correctly with HTTP 200. (3) Search functionality on homepage filters destinations by name, country, and region correctly.

Japan destination page shows Japan-specific packages (Tokyo & Kyoto Classic, Cherry Blossom Special, Japan Alps & Onsen)
India destination page shows India-specific packages (Golden Triangle Classic, Kerala Backwaters & Beaches, Rajasthan Royal Heritage)
Thailand destination page shows Thailand-specific packages (Bangkok & Beaches Classic, Northern Thailand Explorer, Island Hopping Paradise)
Morocco destination page shows Morocco-specific packages (Imperial Cities Circuit, Sahara Desert Explorer, Marrakech & Atlas Mountains)
UAE destination page shows UAE-specific packages (Dubai City Explorer, Dubai & Abu Dhabi Combo, UAE Luxury Collection)
India packages do NOT appear on Greece, Japan, Thailand, Morocco, UAE pages

All 12 destinations have packages defined in seed_data.py
Homepage search filters destinations by name (e.g., 'Japan' shows only Japan)
Homepage search filters destinations by region (e.g., 'Europe' shows Greece and Portugal)

All destination detail sections load without errors (hero, stats, facts, services, packages, regions, food)
